description:
About EasyLlama

EasyLlama is on a mission to end checkbox compliance. We started by reinventing compliance training with engaging, bite-sized, mobile-first learning instead of outdated, one-size-fits-all courses. Today, we're building an AI-powered Human Risk Management platform that helps organizations reduce risk through modern training, policy management, phishing simulations, and intelligent automation. Our goal is to help companies build compliance programs that are effective, measurable, and built for the way people work today.

More than 6,000 organizations, including Shake Shack, WeightWatchers, Sephora, Jiffy Lube, and Y Combinator, trust EasyLlama. We're proudly bootstrapped, profitable, and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list, with a 96% G2 rating and industry-leading NPS and CSAT scores. We move quickly, value ownership and collaboration, and believe the best ideas come from people who are excited to solve meaningful problems and make a real impact.

Our CORE values

DRIVE is how we work at EasyLlama. Weʼre Doers, Resourceful,
Impactful, Valued Partners, & Excellence-Focused.

  • We are Doers. We proactively make things happen.

  • We are Resourceful. We treat time, money, and energy as valuable.

  • We are Impactful. We prioritize what matters.

  • We are Valued Partners. We put customers & teammates first.

  • We are Excellence-Obsessed. We always deliver excellent work.

From CEO to newest hire, DRIVE asks us to take ownership, solve
problems, prioritize what matters, support teammates, and deliver high-
quality work.


When we live these values, our product choices, customer interactions,
hiring, and promotions all help us live out our mission: to build safer and
more productive workplaces.


About the Role

We're looking for a Small Business Account Executive who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and brings a strong sense of accountability, decisiveness, and customer-first thinking. In this role, you’ll take ownership of your territory and drive new business by connecting with small businesses and helping them discover how EasyLlama can transform their compliance training. You'll be persuasive in your communication, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and maintain a consistent commitment to growth, for yourself and your customers.

Responsibilities

New Business Development:

  • Identify, engage, and close new small business opportunities to exceed monthly sales quotas

  • Use persuasive communication to tailor your message to each prospect’s unique needs and context, influencing decision-making and driving value

Product Expertise:

  • Become an expert in EasyLlama’s suite of products to effectively position customer value and key benefits in a way that resonates with each prospect’s unique needs and goals

  • Articulate ideas and information in a straightforward and easily understandable manner

  • Conduct engaging demos that showcase how our solution addresses unique prospect pain points

Full Sales Cycle Management:

  • Own the sales process end-to-end from prospecting to proposal creation and closing

  • Make confident, timely decisions to keep deals moving forward, even in uncertain or fast-changing situations

Pipeline Management:

  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and CRM hygiene to support visibility and forecasting

  • Take accountability for your territory’s performance and proactively adjust strategies to stay on track

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner closely with Customer Support and Success teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new customers and long-term customer happiness

  • Advocate for customer needs internally and help identify opportunities for improvement and innovation within the sales process

About You

  • Customer-First Mindset: You always put prospects at the center of your decision-making and strive to deliver exceptional prospect experiences

  • Persuasive Communicator: You tailor your communication style to your audience, delivering ideas in a clear, compelling way that drives understanding and alignment

  • Decisive and Action-Oriented: You take initiative and make sound decisions with confidence, even in complex, uncertain, and evolving situations

  • Accountable and Goal-Driven: You own your outcomes and consistently follow through on commitments, holding yourself to a high standard

  • Resilient in Ambiguity: You’re comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and are resourceful when things don’t go as planned

  • Committed to Growth: You seek feedback, invest in personal development, and are always learning and improving

Requirements

  • 3+ years of B2B software sales experience in a high-growth SaaS environment

  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and delivering results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Highly organized with strong time management abilities

  • Motivated, adaptable, and excited to work in a collaborative team environment

  • Proficiency in CRM tools and pipeline management best practices

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to HR or People teams

  • Familiarity with compliance training or e-learning platforms

  • Background in selling to businesses with fewer than 200 employees

*To ensure the best employee experience, we offer competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, an annual wellness stipend, PTO, 401k with company matching, and monthly team events to nurture connection!

At EasyLlama, we strive to walk the walk. We are helping make workplaces all over the globe safer and more inclusive, including our own. We honor employees and candidates from all walks of life and all experiences, regardless of race, ethnicity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion.
